blocks.text: Any person cited for a violation of this chapter may appeal in accordance with Chapter 2.45 TMC. However, nothing in this chapter shall prevent the City from prosecuting violations pursuant to TMC 1.10.070 . (Ord. 19699 § 8, 2-7-12.)
